name: Grimwar
storyline:
You are the THAUMATURGE, a spellcaster trapped in the ancient and feared GRIMWAR. When the Archmage succumbs to the power of the tomb, you are freed, only to find yourself trapped within his dark tower.
Using an arsenal of deadly spells strewn across twisting passages, you must escape the tower and defeat the GRIMWAR -- fighting your way through waves of enemies and wall-running across obstacles.
summary:
GRIMWAR is a fast-paced platform shooter with an emphasis on movement, playstyle customization, and low-poly graphics.
Using an arsenal of deadly spells strewn across twisting passages, you must escape the tower and defeat the GRIMWAR -- fighting your way through waves of enemies and wall-running across obstacles.
